title: AI Art Classifier
tagline: Custom CNN for synthetic vs. human artwork detection.
description: Convolutional neural network trained from scratch to distinguish AI-generated artwork from human illustrations, achieving 99.22% validation accuracy across diverse art styles.

title: Diabetes Risk Dashboard
tagline: Multi-model clinical biomarker inference web app.
description: Interactive diagnostic web application comparing six classification pipelines with live biomarker inference and feature importance evaluation on the Pima Indians Diabetes dataset.

title: Dual-RFID Turnstile Access Control System
tagline: Hardware-to-API RFID turnstile controller for automated entry and exit verification.
description: An Arduino-based access control prototype built with dual MFRC522 RFID readers, solenoid relay actuation, and an Ethernet shield that authenticates entry/exit scans against a remote REST API in real time.

title: UIC REC System
tagline: Streamlining academic research ethics reviews from manuscript submission to automated certification
description: A web portal built for the University of the Immaculate Conception's Research Ethics Committee to replace manual email submissions with role-based manuscript tracking, reviewer feedback loops, and one-click ethics compliance certification.
